 Veterans will be treated to free meals, drinks and ice cream Wednesday, Nov. 11, in Norfolk as local businesses and organizations recognize their service on Veterans Day.
 Both Hy-Vee stores in Norfolk will offer free breakfasts to veterans.
 The Norfolk VFW also will serve a free lunch for veterans and their spouses beginning at 11 a.m. The meal will include Windsor loins and scalloped potatoes.
 Hiland Dairy is offering veterans a free 48-ounce container of its Red, White and Boom ice cream. Veterans may stop by the business at 700 E. Norfolk Ave. to receive the free treat.
 Red, White and Boom features strawberry, vanilla and blueberry ice cream.
 Scooter’s Coffee is offering a free medium drink as a special thank-you to veterans and active-duty military members in honor of Veterans Day. Anyone with a valid military ID is invited to receive a free medium drink as a token of gratitude and appreciation for their service and sacrifice. This special offer is valid for any beverage on the Scooter’s Coffee menu.
